schema_description: Синтетический университет: подразделения, преподаватели, студенты, семестры, курсы, записи на курсы и оценки. NULL допускается в teachers.salary, students.birth_date, grades.score, grades.grade_letter, grades.graded_on; уникальность (student_id, course_id, semester_id) в enrollments; CHECK на допустимые оценки, статусы и диапазон дат семестра.

profile_legend.aggregate: одна агрегатная функция или несколько по одной группировке
profile_legend.outer_join_aggregate: внешнее соединение с агрегатом (включая нулевые группы)
profile_legend.anti_join_null: анти-соединение через LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
profile_legend.outer_join_predicate: внешнее соединение с предикатом в ON
profile_legend.semi_anti_join: комбинация EXISTS и NOT EXISTS в одном запросе
profile_legend.anti_join_subquery: анти-соединение через NOT EXISTS в подзапросе
profile_legend.top_n_ties: сортировка с LIMIT при возможных равенствах

breaking_profile_legend.multiplicity: состояние с повторяющимися строками и кратностями
breaking_profile_legend.nullable: состояние с NULL в необязательном столбце
breaking_profile_legend.zero_value: состояние с нулевой суммой или нулевым счётом

ddl: CREATE TABLE departments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL UNIQUE, faculty VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, budget DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, CHECK(budget >= 0))

CREATE TABLE teachers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, hired_at DATE NOT NULL, salary DECIMAL(10,2) NULL, FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments(id), CHECK(title IN ('assistant','lecturer','senior_lecturer','professor')), CHECK(salary IS NULL OR salary >= 0))

CREATE TABLE students(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL UNIQUE, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, enrolled_at DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, birth_date DATE NULL, FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments(id), CHECK(status IN ('active','graduated','expelled','leave')))
CREATE TABLE semesters(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL UNIQUE, starts_on DATE NOT NULL, ends_on DATE NOT NULL, CHECK(ends_on > starts_on))

CREATE TABLE courses(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL UNIQUE, title VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, department_id INTEGER NOT NULL, credits INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments(id), CHECK(credits BETWEEN 1 AND 30))

CREATE TABLE enrollments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_id INTEGER NOT NULL, semester_id INTEGER NOT NULL, teacher_id INTEGER NOT NULL, enrolled_on DATE NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(student_id) REFERENCES students(id), FOREIGN KEY(course_id) REFERENCES courses(id), FOREIGN KEY(semester_id) REFERENCES semesters(id), FOREIGN KEY(teacher_id) REFERENCES teachers(id), UNIQUE(student_id, course_id, semester_id), CHECK(status IN ('enrolled','passed','failed','dropped')))

CREATE TABLE grades(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, enrollment_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, score DECIMAL(5,2) NULL, grade_letter VARCHAR(2) NULL, graded_on DATE NULL, FOREIGN KEY(enrollment_id) REFERENCES enrollments(id), CHECK(score IS NULL OR (score >= 0 AND score <= 100)), CHECK(grade_letter IS NULL OR grade_letter IN ('A','B','C','D','E','F')))
constraints: teachers.title NOT NULL, CHECK(title IN (assistant, lecturer, senior_lecturer, professor))
teachers.salary NULL allowed, CHECK(salary IS NULL OR salary >= 0)
students.status NOT NULL, CHECK(status IN (active, graduated, expelled, leave))
semesters.starts_on NOT NULL, semesters.ends_on NOT NULL, CHECK(ends_on > starts_on)
courses.credits NOT NULL, CHECK(credits BETWEEN 1 AND 30)
enrollments.status NOT NULL, CHECK(status IN (enrolled, passed, failed, dropped))
grades.enrollment_id NOT NULL UNIQUE, REFERENCES enrollments(id)
grades.score NULL allowed, CHECK(score IS NULL OR (score BETWEEN 0 AND 100))
grades.grade_letter NULL allowed, CHECK(grade_letter IS NULL OR grade_letter IN (A, B, C, D, E, F))
